instruction: Candid outdoor full shot of a shirtless man with a man-bun and beard (R1) and a woman in a black one-piece swimsuit (R2) practicing acro-yoga on a sandy beach. The shirtless man (R1) is on the left, leaning back in a deep squat to support the woman (R2) who stands on his thighs. They hold hands tightly, leaning away from each other to maintain balance. The woman (R2) smiles as she balances. The ocean waves roll in the background under an overcast sky, illuminated by natural, diffused daylight.
